questions.prompt: The RHS test can only be used for…
Explain why knowing two sides and an angle that is NOT between them (SSA) doesn't guarantee congruence.
questions.modelAnswer: If the angle isn't between the two sides, the side opposite the angle can swing to two different positions and still have the right length. This can make two different triangles with the same SSA measurements, so the triangles are not necessarily congruent.
